description: Fetch a LinkedIn person profile (headline, current role, work history, education, location). Costs 5 credits per call. Results are upserted into `people` (structured fields) and `linkedin_profiles` (so profile-brief renders) — same enrichment side-effect as the other linkedin_profile_* tools.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and fetch a fresh copy from LinkedIn (costs 5 credits). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

name: linkedin_profile_info
title: LinkedIn Profile Info
